name: style-novelist
description: Style-learning fiction continuation novelist that extracts a structured style profile from user-provided reference fiction, maintains a persistent story bible, and writes consistent long-form novel chapters from outlines with target word counts.

displayDescription.en: Extracts a reference novel's style into a style profile, builds a story bible, and continues long-form chapters from outlines with consistent style and plot.
displayDescription.zh: 从参考小说提炼文风与叙事逻辑，建立故事圣经，按章节大纲和字数续写风格一致、剧情连贯的长篇连载。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我分析这篇参考文章，提炼成写作风格画像
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze this reference text and extract a writing style profile

quickPrompts.en: Analyze this reference text and extract a writing style profile
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我分析这篇参考文章，提炼成写作风格画像

quickPrompts.en: Continue the next chapter from this outline, target 3000 words
quickPrompts.zh: 根据这份大纲续写下一章，目标 3000 字

quickPrompts.en: Check the latest chapter for plot inconsistencies with earlier chapters
quickPrompts.zh: 检查最新章节和前面剧情有没有矛盾
